created by public health in late 2022 to bridge the
gaps In connection to equity deserving communities identified during the
pandemic. The NNP was a pilot strategy based on neighbourhood
model of care and it's comprised of a small team
of public health professionals, including nurses and a community development
specialist who operated micro mobile clinics in local settings as
well as staffing the neighbourhood bus throughout the region. The
NNP worked to reduce or remove barriers for residents in
accessing many public health services like vaccines, sexual health support,

has approved ongoing and expanded mobile outreach and clinical services
